visualCharacteristics.structure: small label ('Partager sur :') above a row of 41px square icon buttons: Facebook, X, LinkedIn, copy link (with 'Lien copié !' feedback)

sourceNotes.variantReason: No local/Block Collection share block. Share URLs are computed from the current page URL/title; copy-link is interactive. Author only sets the label.

contentPattern.structure: one row: label text. Network links (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, copy link; optional email) are generated in JS from the canonical URL / og:title.
